description.en-US: Apps by Frantz Vardman. Get them through Free Lane.

summary.en-US: Order Bayou Burger: gourmet burgers with southern soul, Houston

description.en-US: Browse the full Bayou Burger menu with prices and order delivery on DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub or Instacart. Open 24 hours. No account needed.

summary.en-US: BETA · Your sign-in codes, no internet, no Google

description.en-US: Vindie Authenticator: two-step sign-in codes for GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, Facebook and any site that offers an authenticator app. No internet permission at all, so your secrets can never leave the phone. Fingerprint or screen-lock protected, hidden from screenshots, encrypted with the phone's hardware key, and backed up only to a file locked with your own passphrase. Imports from Google Authenticator in one scan.

summary.en-US: Riddles, torches and five caves

description.en-US: Cave Hunt: build your village, raid five story caves, answer riddles before your torch burns out, and earn up to 3 stars a cave. Easy, Medium and Hard.

summary.en-US: A plain-English check-up for your business

description.en-US: Paperwork, red flags, money and plain talk: a score, a fix list with official sources and a PDF report.

summary.en-US: Catch the gold, dodge the bombs

description.en-US: Bombs & Bullion: a one-thumb arcade game starring 10 animal superheroes. Catch the gold, dodge the bombs, grab the lightning to unleash your hero's power, and beat the Bomb King. Offline.

summary.en-US: A free app store with no gatekeepers

description.en-US: Install and update free apps. Every download is checked against its SHA-256 fingerprint before it installs. Sign in once, no ads.

summary.en-US: A side-view shooter: endless rooms, 4 giants

description.en-US: Giants & Guns: run, jump and blast your way through room after room while your gun aims itself. Level up and pick power-ups like Purple Love Slime, Bounce Ball, Boom Headphones and the Haymaker Glove, then take down Big Head, Brow, Grimjaw and KRAMP the Sleeping Giant. Free and offline, nothing collected. Want more? The Gold Edition (no ads, 500 gold, the Golden Gatling) is in the Frantz Vardman Shop.

summary.en-US: Films, trailers and a studio you can order from

description.en-US: J & F Studios: watch the CHICO: The Creole Crown trailer, see what the studio makes, and ask for a quote on trailers, title cards, music videos and remasters. For members: sign in with your shop account.

summary.en-US: Credit repair you do yourself: Learn, Make, Record, Send

description.en-US: Learn your credit rights, make dispute and debt-validation letters that cite the exact law, track every legal deadline, and print or share them. Free, no account, no ads, no internet permission.

summary.en-US: A genius monkey escapes the lab

description.en-US: Monkey Money: run, jump and blast bananas through 10 stages, grab power-ups, unlock rarer monkeys and beat the lab director's mech.

summary.en-US: BETA · Merch for independent artists

description.en-US: BETA. Palm Distribute Music: apply in three quick steps, set up your own merch store and artist page, and keep your rights. Checkout opens in your browser. No trackers.

summary.en-US: Your game, your goals, your next session

description.en-US: Vindie Player HQ: plan your next session, track your own goals, money, garage and notes for GTA VI or any open-world game. A live session clock in your notifications, shortcuts on the icon, works with no signal. Your data stays on your phone unless you tap Save. Nothing from any game is used; independent and not affiliated with any game publisher. Free while in beta.

summary.en-US: Make beats from scratch: drum pads and a live step grid

description.en-US: Beat Pad: 8 pads, a 16-step grid that plays live, tempo, swing, 3 kits and 4 patterns. Plus an idea maker. Every sound is made on your phone (no samples). Export the beat with stems and a certificate of originality.

summary.en-US: Protect your name, number and peace

description.en-US: Log evidence of harassment or misuse of your name and number, write takedown, data-broker and stop-contact letters that state the law accurately, and find the right help. Free, no account, no internet permission.

summary.en-US: Keep your ID and papers safe on your phone

description.en-US: Encrypted vault, reminders and help guides in English, Spanish and Haitian Creole. No internet permission.

summary.en-US: The Frantz Vardman Shop in your pocket

description.en-US: Frantz Vardman Shop: browse planners, guides, games extras and music tools. Checkout opens on the secure Stripe page; the app collects nothing about you.

summary.en-US: Stay in touch with people nearby when there's no signal

description.en-US: Phone-to-phone chat, supplies board, shared places and sourced first aid. No internet needed.

summary.en-US: Step into the dark: fight, loot, go deeper

description.en-US: Vindie Dungeon Crawler (VDC): a first-person dungeon crawler. Pick a Knight, Ranger or Mage, step through torch-lit halls one square at a time, fight monsters, open chests, level up and face a boss every 5th floor. RIZZ22's paintings hang on the walls; TheMarket777 plays the soundtrack..

summary.en-US: BETA · Advertise your business on Frantz Vardman sites and apps

description.en-US: BETA. Vindie Ads: book an ad for your business. Add a headline, picture and link, see a live preview, pay in your browser, and track your ad's views. Ads rotate fairly with no trackers.

summary.en-US: BETA · Your passport chip, checked on your phone

description.en-US: Vindie ID: reads your e-passport or chip ID card over NFC on your own phone and checks it against the issuing government's digital signature. Your ID stays encrypted on the phone (no internet permission). Share only what you choose, like over 18 or your name, as a signed QR code that expires in 5 minutes; anyone can check it in their browser.

summary.en-US: New games, apps and tools, the day they land

description.en-US: Vindie News: every new game, app and tool from Frantz Vardman, the day it lands, plus every app in Free Lane in one place. Read the latest issues, share them, and subscribe by email if you like. No account and no ads; the app collects nothing.

summary.en-US: Lead finder for roofing and window teams

description.en-US: Find, track and follow up on leads.

summary.en-US: Know what's safe to spend until payday

description.en-US: Offline budget app: bills, debts, subscriptions and a cash-flow timeline. No bank login.
